notes: חֵיל הַצָּבָא → *the army* read as a rule-30 fusion of the two nouns headed on the construct, with the rectum's article taking the single written *the*; the alternative (*army* on חַיִל alone, צָבָא unrepresented) is named in the unit note.
*to battle* is a supplied run with no source morpheme; one added unit (rule 2).

*when ... go out* placed on the infinitive construct as rectum of עֵת, since the לְ already holds *at* (rule 52's spent-preposition count); the apodosis waw takes the frame's *that* written at the apodosis head (rule 45).
